dedupe_keys.name: mndot traffic data volume classification weight and forecasts minnesota

description: The Minnesota Department of Transportation collects thousands of traffic counts on Minnesota roadways each year and uses them to produce volume, vehicle classification, speed and weight data, traffic forecasts, vehicle miles travelled figures, reports, maps and analysis. Products include annual average daily traffic and heavy commercial AADT, classification into 13 vehicle types, axle weight data and forecasts of future volumes and loads on road segments; they are used in federal reporting, safety evaluation, pavement design, funding decisions, forecasting and modelling. The most complete view is the Transportation Data Management System, and a separate data tools site (data.dot.state.mn.us/datatools) is linked; that host timed out when read on 26 September 2026. Coverage is statewide. Access is free through the web pages and TDMS. Caveats: the licence is not stated on the page read, and the data tools site could not be checked. The data support road network flow and capacity planning models, pavement loading and freight studies. They complement the FHWA HPMS and Caltrans PeMS data catalogued here.
